purpose: Single Applicable Margin definition encodes four pricing eras keyed to First/Third/Fourth Amendment Effective Dates — multi-amendment same definition with query-date sensitivity.
expectedFailClosedBehavior: Operative margin for a query date must select the correct era subclause (A)/(B)/(C)/(D). If a referenced Amendment Effective Date is CONDITIONAL_UNRESOLVED, the engine must not invent which subclause applies.

sourcePointers.quote: (D) at any time on or following the Fourth Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 2.50% per annum, and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 1.50% per annum
